summary: Endless solitaire games. Play, learn, create, offline.
description:
Dive into the ultimate solitaire collection with 250+ Solitaire Collection! Discover an unparalleled world of card games, featuring an astounding 253 unique solitaire games packed into one incredible app. Whether you're a seasoned card player or just starting your patience journey, this is the definitive free solitaire experience you've been searching for.

Unleash endless hours of fun with all your favorite solitaire games and exciting new variations:

* Classic Solitaire: Master timeless classics like Freecell, Klondike, Canfield, Golf, Spider, Scorpion, Pyramid, and Tri-Peaks.
* Original Solitaire Games: Explore a vast array of unique and challenging solitaire variants you won't find anywhere else.

Master Any Solitaire Game with Ease:
Never feel overwhelmed by a new game again! Our solitaire collection includes robust learning tools:
* Interactive Demos: Watch step-by-step video guides for every single game, showing you exactly how to play.
* Comprehensive Rules: Access detailed text descriptions for each patience game, covering the game's purpose, foundation and tableau piles, stock regulations, and placement. Easily understand the intricacies of any card game.

Unprecedented Customization & Creativity:
This isn't just a solitaire collection; it's your personal solitaire workshop!
* Modify Game Rules: Tailor the experience by adjusting the rules of most existing solitaire games to suit your preference.
* Create Your Own Solitaire Games: Design entirely new solitaire games from scratch using popular frameworks like Freecell, Klondike, Algerian Patience, Scorpion, Canfield, Pyramid, and Golf. Imagine and play your own unique card challenges!

Tailored for Every Solitaire Enthusiast:
Customize every aspect of your playing environment for the perfect solitaire game session:
* Visual Themes: Personalize your app's look with various visual themes.
* Card Styles: Choose from diverse card designs and back views.
* Game Table Backgrounds: Select the perfect backdrop for your game.
* Sound Schemes: Enjoy a personalized audio experience.
* Language Options: Play in your preferred language.
* Seamless Play: Enjoy a stable, calm, and pleasant experience on both phones and tablets, with backup functionality ensuring your progress is always safe.

Play Anytime, Anywhere – No WiFi Needed!
This incredible solitaire collection offers offline solitaire gameplay, meaning you can dive into your favorite card games whenever and wherever you want, without an internet connection.

Get ready to experience the ultimate solitaire collection on your Android 6.0 or higher device. Download 250+ Solitaire Collection now and unlock a world of endless solitaire fun!
